profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer ➤Application Development ➤Database Integration ➤System Architecture ➤I build, test & deploy web applications focused on ease-of-use, task-driven functionality & consistent user experience
profile.summary:
𝐖𝐇𝐘 𝐒𝐎𝐅𝐓𝐖𝐀𝐑𝐄 𝐄𝐍𝐆𝐈𝐍𝐄𝐄𝐑𝐈𝐍𝐆?
My interest in programming began the first time I started using computers. I was immediately hooked!

As my career has evolved, I still am just as excited as I was back then in learning how to use different programming languages and software development frameworks to build, test, and optimize high-impact, responsive solutions.

One of my most formative experiences was managing an entire IT Department, including its systems architecture, database administration, network security, integration testing, and legacy application modernization. This experience served as a training ground for my future roles as a senior software engineer. I would use my IT infrastructure knowledge to develop and deploy web-based applications across diverse business systems.

𝐌𝐘 𝐂𝐎𝐑𝐄 𝐒𝐓𝐑𝐄𝐍𝐆𝐓𝐇𝐒:
My technical experience covers the full technology stack.

One of my core strengths is my ability to take a high-level view of individual issues and their impact across a system while leading and working with teams to execute design and development at the lower level.

I have applied my systems thinking in diverse industries, including manufacturing, insurance, and medical education. These experiences have given me a new perspective on how to build software projects and reflect on problems from different angles. My technical background, combined with my MBA, helps me analyze and align technology and business elements to organizational goals.

𝐓𝐄𝐂𝐇𝐍𝐈𝐂𝐀𝐋 𝐓𝐎𝐎𝐋𝐁𝐎𝐗:
Languages: C#, T-SQL, JavaScript 

Software Frameworks: ASP.NET, MVC, WPF, ASP.NET Web API, Entity Framework, ReactJS, SQL Server, Dapper, Knockout, Caliburn.Micro, Dependency Injection, FluentMigrator

Development Tools: Visual Studio, ReSharper, Git, Subversion

Agile Practices: Test-Driven Development (TDD), Object-Oriented Design (OOD), Kanban, Pair Programming, Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Owner/Software Engineer ➤ERP Optimization ➤Digital Transformation ➤Business Process Improvement
positions.description:
𝐓𝐄𝐂𝐇𝐍𝐈𝐂𝐀𝐋 𝐒𝐂𝐎𝐏𝐄:
Since 2016, I've been working in a software engineering consulting and lead architect capacity to drive the development, testing, and maintenance of ERP software on behalf of my former employer, Henning Industrial Software.

I have been working with the Development team in designing, testing, and troubleshooting business process improvements and CI/CD systems. Additionally, I've had opportunities to mentor both junior- and senior-level Developers on C#, SQL Server, design patterns, and unit testing methods.

𝐌𝐀𝐈𝐍 𝐇𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐋𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐓𝐒:

① Digital Transformation – I used the initial frameworks I developed in 2013 to modernize the existing ERP system, deploying programs to execute database migrations, code generation, and data conversion from FoxPro into SQL Server.

② Inventory Tracking – I revamped the inventory sub-system and its processes for tracking information by working closely with the original code designer to identify flow issues, test multiple iterations, and implement improvements that ensured consistent inventory tracking.

③ Accounting System – For the past couple of years, I have worked on overhauling the accounting system, designing features similar to QuickBooks, and implementing testing to validate the computing accuracy of financial data in real-time.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer ➤SQL Database ➤Data Conversion & Migration ➤Unit/Integration Testing
positions.description:
𝐓𝐄𝐂𝐇𝐍𝐈𝐂𝐀𝐋 𝐒𝐂𝐎𝐏𝐄: 
I presided over a SQL Server to Postgres conversion initiative, which involved interpreting a lot of complex code written by a former employee.

I identified, broke down, and updated 25-50 stored procedures into smaller routines, converted them to C#, and ran unit and integration tests to validate and ensure the outputs between C# and SQL was the same.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer ➤JavaScript-based Application Development ➤Programming & Design Patterns
positions.description:
𝐓𝐄𝐂𝐇𝐍𝐈𝐂𝐀𝐋 𝐒𝐂𝐎𝐏𝐄:
I was brought on board to drive the design, implementation, debugging, and conversion of existing WebForm applications and pages to MVC/SPA, Angular, and Durandal frameworks.

This experience also provided opportunities to train, mentor, and introduce software development practices to the Junior Developers, including test-driven development methods, dependency injection design patterns, and best coding practices.

𝐌𝐀𝐈𝐍 𝐇𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐋𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐓𝐒:

① Software Frameworks – I created and introduced 2 internal frameworks into FormFire's web applications that improved user experience across multiple projects, including complicated client-facing pages involving data entry.

② Application Development – I collaborated on a major project to develop, test, and deploy a SAML Single Sign-On mechanism into a vendor application. My team and I were able to complete it just under the wire.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer ➤Web Application Optimization ➤Software Development Frameworks
positions.description:
𝐓𝐄𝐂𝐇𝐍𝐈𝐂𝐀𝐋 𝐒𝐂𝐎𝐏𝐄:
I joined this ERP solutions provider, supporting the diagnosis, debugging, and optimization of existing desktop client applications based on WPF and ASP.Net frameworks.

𝐌𝐀𝐈𝐍 𝐇𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐋𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐓𝐒:
One of my key contributions was getting to lead the initial development and implementation of a software framework to facilitate the conversion from legacy Visual FoxPro applications to SQL Server/WPF platforms. Later, I would expand on this effort when rejoining Henning in a consulting capacity in 2016.

I also trained and mentored the development team on C#, SOLID principles, and test-driven development methodology.

positions.title: IT Director/Senior Software Engineer ➤Web Development ➤System Conversion & Modernization
positions.description:
𝐓𝐄𝐂𝐇𝐍𝐈𝐂𝐀𝐋 𝐒𝐂𝐎𝐏𝐄:
Initially, I was hired, pre-Y2K, to rearchitect, rebuild, and replace the legacy mini mainframe with a modern Windows/SQL Server-based system. Later, I managed the entire IT Department, including its networks, systems, and database infrastructure, and developed new web and native client applications for specific users' needs.

𝐌𝐀𝐈𝐍 𝐇𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐋𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐓𝐒:
During this time, I designed and implemented multiple improvements that modernized this non-profit's IT infrastructure.

① Website Optimization – I designed, developed, and maintained the website's performance by deploying MVC frameworks and design patterns that simplified debugging and testing activities.

② System Modernization – I implemented CI/CD and connected processes that automated and continuously monitored legacy system architectures, third-party integrations, and SQL storage archives that streamlined code releases.

③ Server Infrastructure – I delivered server reliability, availability, and utilization improvements by leading a virtualization initiative that reduced the number of servers from 7 to 3, created significant cost savings, and increased IT scalability.

④ Business Continuity – I wrote and implemented the organization's disaster recovery plan and led the transition from a tape- to a cloud-based backup system, which reduced the burden on IT and increased data accessibility
